rapport_notes: Warm, professional tone; clear speech; good pacing and customer acknowledgment throughout the call.
process_discipline_notes: After 'Does that make sense?' regarding pricing explanation, rep did not hold silence—immediately continued into estimate anchor without pause for customer processing.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Let's start with a few questions. To get us on the right track. And this should take about eight to ten minutes of your time. Then we'll be able to build you an accurate quote.
evidence_quotes.agenda: Bear with me do we have any specific concerns or any important things that you wanted to answer during this call?
evidence_quotes.concern_raised: Yes I would prefer to have at least like three movers. Maybe three or four because some of the furniture is like really big and long and heavy.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_shallow: Okay, no worries we'll go ahead and take note of that. [Immediate pivot to logistics: 'Give me one sec, alright, to just to make sure, have you tried to request for a quote online?']
evidence_quotes.sheet1_covered: We have no worry damage coverage included on the already weigh that you're paying us. We will provide up to 2000 dollars per move that is to repair, replace and reimburse for your items.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_covered: We have meter for future, so few days before your move we will be sending out emails letting you know who will be your movers are in that way it will help ease detention of strangers arriving at the front door.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: We have on time guarantee we value your time. So, if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.
evidence_quotes.communication: [Day-before email notification of movers named above, plus:] It will also give you a brief overview of how our communication will work leading up to your move.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: A typical three bedroom appointment would normally take two movers between five to seven hours. To completely move-in your case we're coming from a three bedroom apartment located on the fourth floor with elevators going to the new location which is like forty minutes away from the first location, this is a one story house. So, we'll send out the three movers and one truck estimated time is between five to six hours estimated cost is $1,870.
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_window: So, that would still really depends on how well prepared you are. So in case if you still have extra time just to prepare but in the small items into your boxes yourself that would really help to keep the time done in efficiency up.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: In case if you just end up less than that would be okay, you only need to pay once the job is done and only for the actual hours.
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: So in case if you still have extra time just to prepare but in the small items into your boxes yourself that would really help to keep the time done in efficiency up. Obviously the last time we take the less money end up spending by the end of the day.
evidence_quotes.close_ask_weak: Would you like me to lock that in for you?

top_strength: Excellent quid pro quo framing (8–10 minute time-box + accurate quote promise) and flawless coverage of all four differentiators (damage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time, Communication) with specific language and detail.
coaching_note: After asking the customer's agenda concern (three+ movers needed), rep acknowledged but did not dig deeper—should have asked 'Tell me more about that' or 'What else is on your list?' to reach two layers before pivoting to logistics; also missing rate-lock confirmation and clearer close ask in Stage 3.
